what_happened: Checked the 20 tasks named in this task's migration-provenance territory-contention list against the live specs/state.json rather than trusting the migration-time snapshot; all 20 are already status:completed, so the apparent heavy contention over issue-record.sh/issue-log.md/git-commit-phase.sh was stale and did not need serialization against this research. Confirms migration-provenance contention lists should always be re-derived at dispatch time, as their own text already instructs.

Plan-time discovery that removes a step the task description assumed: common_test_resolve_subject honours CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store, so test-issue-record.sh can exercise the edited source-store issue-record.sh in its own scratch .claude/scripts mirror with no deploy, despite deploy-root-guard refusing direct source-store invocation. The plan's first three phases verify without a redeploy as a result; the redeploy is scheduled once, in the final phase, for the separate reason that new suite cases fail against the stale deployed subject in default deploy-tree-first mode.

validate-artifact.sh --strict's Tier Justification measurement caught three genuinely under-narrow justifications in the first draft of this plan: each named only the one suite that exercises the edited source-store copy, while suite_selection_select resolves 16, 8 and 15 suites respectively for those phases' paths. Re-authored each justification to name the deferred remainder explicitly and say why it cannot run before the final phase's redeploy (deploy-tree-first subject resolution; deployed-vs-source comparators). Cost ~10 minutes; the check prevented three plausible-looking but incomplete coverage claims.

Phase 4's verify-touched.sh run (scoped to this task's 4 own touched paths: issue-record.sh, test-issue-record.sh, orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh, issue-log.md) pulled in test-orchestrate-conclusion-roadmap.sh via suite-selection mapping and that suite's Case H failed: 'expected literal /please and /merge lines' -- stderr shows the /please line but no /merge line. This is unrelated to task 639's own edits: milestone-review-handoff.sh and review-stack-prepare.sh are outside this task's file_scope and were never touched here. Git history shows recent concurrent sibling commits 70f77aa77 (task 691 phase 3: move refs, rewrite the manifest, and redeploy) and 9d9386f1c (task 692 phase 1: wire cut/show and the refusal arm) touching the stack-based PR/merge flow; task 691's own declared file_scope includes review-stack-prepare.sh. This looks like a sibling-task-induced test/implementation drift (the stack-mode merge flow no longer emits a literal /merge line this test still expects), not a regression caused by task 639. Not fixed here -- out of this task's declared scope (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/issue-record.sh, its test suite, orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh, context/formats/issue-log.md).
